talking_points.text: Michigan issuers reported $29.1M sold across 7 Form D filings this week, down 79% vs. the prior 4-week average. The largest was Ajc Auburn Hills Investments LLC (Bloomfield Hills, Other Real Estate) targeting $22.2M. Good question to ask: are founders in real estate favoring equity rounds over venture debt right now?

Rocket Companies, Inc. (RKT) disclosed a deal with Mr. Cooper Group Inc.. It was one of 5 M&A filings this week. Use it to ask how buyers are valuing Michigan financial services assets and whether consolidation is accelerating.

6 Michigan-based pooled funds filed Form Ds, reporting $13.5M raised so far — led by Baselake Partners, LP (Hedge Fund). A natural opener: what are LPs asking Michigan sponsors for in today's fundraising market?
